balls.text: slower ball across him, toe-ends it to the keeper as he tries the big hit, Salt misses and Marsh doesn't try anything fancy. A single ensues
caught at long-on. pin-drop silence. Just no pace to work with. Slower-ball legcutter, into the pitch, and Dhoni goes down the ground and finds long-on
looks to hide it away outside off but concedes a wide
slower ball again, swiped to deep midwicket for one
slower bouncer, and Chahar makes no connection. The best result for DC. Dhoni reviews for a wide. Replays confirm the call on the field is right
same play. Same ball, Jadeja tries the same shot, but this is the slower legcutter, and not full enough. All he manages is a mi9is-hit to long-on. The crowd goes quiet
full and wide, trying to hide it away, gives him pace on, and Jadeja sweeps it back over his head for four. Amazing how he has reached it and connected it so well

Dhoni is turning it on. He is not fully fit. He has had a slow start. And then he has chosen his balls and his areas and made up. Slower ball, just short of a length, outside off, and he lofts it back over his head for a flat six
slower ball, short of a length, punched straight of deep cover, and they come back for two
Dhoni has a big swing at a wide length ball at 138ks, and gets a thick edge over short third for four
fuller, wider, quicker, 137ks, and beats Dhoni's swing. Called a wide, and they are not reviewing it
just a touch too predictable. Slower short ball outside off, and Dhoni is expecting it. Slaps a pull over midwicket for six
Jadeja is backing away, and Khaleel follows him with a pinpoint yorker. Just the leg-bye
short of a length, slower ball, wide, pulled into the leg side, and Dhoni hobbles through for one
full and wide, drilled down to long-off where Warner misfields allows them a second through a misfield
he has glanced a wide ball down to short fine, and Dhoni, who is managing his knee, is not running these quick ones
that is fired in at 116ks. Jadeja is unable to react. Gets a bottom edge
quicker, 95ks, on a length, on the pads, and has Jadeja been run out taking the second? No he isn't. The throw is on a half-volley, and it is difficult for Salt to collect
down the wicket, Kuldeep looks to cramp him up, but Jadeja makes just enough room to be able to loft him over long-on for six. Important shot for CSK
down the leg side, called wide
quick, turning away, outside off, beats him. The length is perfect
short of a length, no room, punched to long-on
short of a length, slower ball, 125ks, punched to deep cover for one
left alone in the 17th over. On-pace, 135ks, short ball, loopy bounce. Dhoni just lets it go
slower ball, short of a length, beats his attempt to cut. On the bounce to Salt
he has to go for big hits, and Khaleel is smart enough to drag it wide, and Rayudu sweeps it from wide outside off straight to long-on. But guess what? It has brought on huge cheers from the crowd
makes room to run this shortish ball to deep third for one
flat, on a length, 90ks, punched down to long-off
looking to tuck him up but angles too far down the leg side
looks like the wrong'un, 82ks, middle and leg, Rayudu looks to lap it, gets a top edge for am single to short fine
pushes this wide, and Rayudu is happy with the extra
nice drift in, middle and leg, dropped into the leg side for a single
on a length, middle and leg, turning in, pushed to long-on for one
misfielded by Lalit at extra cover, allows Jadeja the single
on a length, around off, punched to deep cover for one
legcutter, 122ks, wicket to wicket, Rayudu opens the face and takes a single
gives pace to Jadeja again, 133ks, and he runs it down to deep third for another single
slower short ball, pulled away to deep square leg
short of a length, pace on, 130ks, runs this down to deep third
he has the field set for this ball, and finally bowls the ball for that field. Short of a length, at his body, 118ks, Dube pulls it into the big side of the ground, and toe-ends it to deep midwicket
tries to hide this away from him and concedes another wide. This was pace on
short, slower ball, cut away in front of square but straight to extra cover
slower4 ball, angled away from him, too wide
Lalit stays on a good length, but Rayudu leaves the crease late and turns this into a slot ball and lofts it back over his head for six more. Just the over CSK needed
on a length, around off, defended to leg
stays deep in the crease, plays this shortish ball late, and pulls it to the left of of short fine and right of deep square leg
fired in, shorter, wider, punched to deep cover

pulls the length back from the last time but Dube's long levers meet it, and even though he has hit this higher than the last one, he has got enough to clear long-on. This is not an easy shot on this pitch
overpitched, and Dube hits his second six. Clears the front leg, and lofts him straight back over his head. Lovely high back lift and a fluent down swing
slower ball again, 118ks, wide length ball, driven to deep cover
finally pace on the ball, 136ks, short of a length, driven on the up to deep cover for one
slower bouncer, pulled down to long leg for a single
fuller one now, still pace off the ball, 117ks, driven to long-off for one
another legcutter, short of a length, Rayudu opens the face, can't beat backward point
starts off with a leg-cutter, into the pitch, Rayudu gets on top of the bounce and cuts it square of deep cover
flighted outside off, driven to long-off for a single
quick, into the pads, 98ks, pushed to short straight midwicket
on a length, on off, pushed past cover for one
stays back to a length-ball offbreak, opens the face, takes a single to short third
turn for Lalit, nudged into the leg side with soft hands, and they come back for two

sensational catch. He has dived to his right, up to where the non-striker stands. Even the umpire has made an O with his lips. One-handed skimmer. However, if he had dropped it and collected it, Dube would have been run out because he is so far down the pitch
slow in the air, 88ks, Rahane drops and runs, and takes the single to cover m
into the pads, trying to take his arms away from him. Nudged to leg for one
on a length, 96ks, punched to deep cover for one
goes slow in the air, 84ks, nearly a yorker, driven down to long-on for one
and there is the first. Right in Dube's wheelhouse and has pace on it. Dube plants the front foot down, and lofts it with a lovely clean swing over wide long-on. First boundary in 29 balls
on a length, quick, punched down to long-on
wrong'un again, Rahane flicks this off the pads for one
wrong'un first up, Dube's back lift is still big, but he adjusts off the pitch and takes a single to long-on

that's probably why they are not taking risks. Moeen skips down the wicket, Kuldeep goes slow again, 84ks, and again goes wide. Moeen has to reach out, and the turn takes the edge for a catch to backward point
down the wicket, Kuldeep slows it down, 88ks, and also goes down leg, Rahane misses the ball but has his pads behind its line. Gets a leg-bye
first sign of intent, and this is not short enough for the pull. Moeen ends up getting a leading edge to long-off for one
goes back to a quick length ball, worked to leg for one
fired in at 92ks, and gets some turn in to beat his flick. Missing leg, though
slower in the air, 89ks, Rahane glances this to short fine for one
overpitched, but they are not taking risks. Just the single to long-on
on a length, into the pads, 96ks, worked into the leg side for one
punched down to long-off for one
Warner makes a superb dive and throw in one motion at short straight midwicket to not just deny them a single but also make Rahane rush back into the crease
looks like the slider, beats the inside edge as he flicks this. Will get a leg-bye, though
on a length, turns in a touch, punched down to long-on
turns this off the pads to short fine for one
misfielded by KD to his left as this is hit softly back to him. Just gets into a tangle with Moeen
wrong'un, Rahane plays it off the surface, 84ks, punched to extra cover
middle and leg, on a length, 96ks, worked to leg for one
after that leading edge, this one goes straight on, and beats the inside edge. Missing leg, though
full, just outside off, played with the turn, gets a single to long-on
turn for a 92ks delivery. Axar has gone roundarm and fired this in. Rahane gets a leading edge that falls safely in the covers
tight line, nudged into the leg side for one
on a length, at off, defended back

first ball after powerplay, and Gaikwad is gone. Axar has wickets off the first ball of both his overs. I think Gaikwad is looking to chip this over extra cover, but the ball holds up in the pitch and he ends up hitting it towards long-off. The fielder there is not all the way to the fence, which allows him to come in and take the catch
short of a length, 125ks, Gaikwad drops and runs, and gets the single
Gaikwad backs away, and he follows him with a slower yorker. Gaikwad digs it out, and the deep midwicket is now back, which allows them time to take two
fuller, just outside off, driven to mid-off. Doesn't look the easiest pitch to time your shots on
another legcutter but a touch too short, and Gaikwad pulls it over midwicket for four. Goes in front of square because there is a deep square leg in place
legcutter, 126ks, on a length, just outside off, defended
on a length, wicket to wicket, glanced to short fine for one
flatter, shorter, nudged into the leg side for one
lovely batting. The old-fashioned chip over extra cover. Axar is quick but slightly too full, and Rahane is in attacking mood at least while the field is up
fired in now, Rahane goes back to defend the length ball
superb intent from Rahane. What a season. This is not even overpitched, but he has swung through its line and lofted it over mid-on
full, on off, defended back

another early sweep, beaten again, and he is given out. Conway has a chat with Gaikwad, but decides not to review. The only question perhaps is, has he got himself outside the line? I think it is umpire's call on impact. Other than he has missed the length completely, and also chosen the wrong line. In fact he has not chosen anything. He has premeditated
length ball, no turn, beats his inside edge again. Going down, though

another sweep, but this time the line is right: outside off. He is beaten by lack of turn, and Salt tries to steal one. The third umpire is called into play. No edge. Salt waits and waits and waits for Conway to move his back foot, and then flicks the bail off, but the back foot moves too briefly for him to sneak in the stumping. Tell you what this would have riled the crowd up had he got Conway
down the wicket, ends up playing in front of the body, but he has managed to loft it beyond Lalit's hands as he goes for an overhead catch
worked into the leg side for one

big big shout for lbw, not given, and they have reviewed it. Seems to me a question of whether Conway has hit it as he is done in on the sweep. Goes down the sweep early, Lalit stays flat and straight, the ball stays a touch low, but he has gloved it onto the pad. Otherwise it looks dead for all money. Actually UltraEdge shows it is not the glove, but the inside edge. A tiny tiny edge. That is very close. I think the fielders saw the deviation on the first replay and walked back to their positions, but the UltraEdge doesn't show that big an edge. That murmur was not big
on a length, outside off, punched to extra cover
on a length, think it has seamed away a touch, punched straight to mid-off. Hit too well to be stealing a single
whipped away off the pads, gets a single to long leg
short of a length, around off, runs it down to deep third for one
heavy length, in and around off, dropped into the leg side for one
tucks him up, flicked away off the hip for two to long leg

big swing and a miss. They have got the ball moving. Ishant with the legcutters, and Khaleel just shapes it away from the big waft from Conway outside off. Khaleel says he heard something. Nobody else agrees. They don't review. Replays show a little bit of scratch as the ball passes the edge. A miss for DC
another legcutter, but this time Gaikwad gives a tap on top of it as it is a touch too short. Placed past point for four
Ishant is bowling beautiful legcutters but they are all getting edged for fours. Cat5ch to gully in a Test as Gaikwad defends this, but there is no gully in T20s. Goes to the right of short third
slower short ball, 117ks, into the ribs, beats his pull, goes for a leg-bye
slides down leg, and is called a wide
inswinger, turned to leg for a single

that's unlukcy for Ishant. Looks like the legcutter. Yes it is the legcutter. Bowled at 138ks. On a length. Gaikwad looks to open the face but gets an edge that goes just wide of Salt. Takes the top of his finger on the way
looking for the inswinger, driven on the up, straight to extra cover
short of a length, a touch too wide, and called too
slightly shimmy down the wicket, Khaleel shortens the length, pushed to point
looks to tuck him up but slides down the leg side
this time Warner puts in a full-length dive to his right at mid-off to keep this drive down to one
on a length, outside off, pushed wide of point for one
Warner slips while gathering this drive straight to him at mid-off. Concedes a single with the misfield
wide length ball, played straight to short cover
short of a length, just outside off, defended
slower ball, full, Kuldeep keeps it out for a 0 not out
finally gets one on target. A slower ball at 130ks, totally flummoxes Lait, and the length ball cannons into the middle of middle stump
misses the yorker as he follows him, and Lalit manages to get bat on the high full toss for four through backward square leg
bouncer, ramped away over backward point for four more
short of a length, into the ribs, pulled away off the hip for four through long leg
full and straight, struck to long-on for one
another wide, and Dhoni collects this by his shoe laces
wide length ball. Too wide. Half-volleys Dhoni. A bit of a painful take for him
wide full toss, past the bat. Another dot

he has got away with the top edge but he has been run out. Yet another slog, gets a massive top edge, which falls in no man's land behind the bowler, but Ripal is at the non-striker's end while Aman has not reacted. Moeen has a shy at the striker's, and catches him short
slower ball, swings hard at it, gets a thick edge over short third for one
full and wide, drilled straight to long-off for one
wide yorker, just outside the blue line, but not called. DC not interested in a review
full, on-pace, sliced to deep point for two
those are unlucky runs for CSK. Another wicked yorker from Pathirana, takes his toe even as he tries to save them, and then ricochets away from Dhoni for four leg-byes
lovely deception. Slower ball, 132ks, and Axar is early into it even though the length is right in the slot. It is just too good. Axar ends up checking the shot, and is caught at wide long-on
nearly a yorker, driven down to long-on for one
yorker this time, dug out down the ground for one
Axar is batting beautifully here. You have to be really good to pick on a small error in length, and he lofts him over extra cover
slides this down leg side for a wide
nails the yorker. Just outside off. At 146ks, It should swing in, but this one swings away late, and that is why the off stump is still standing
goes for the wide yorker, overcooks it
carrom ball. Almighty slog from Ripal, and he is beaten on the outside edge. Somehow the ball misses the off stump
quicker, straighter, cloffed to long-off for one

whatever might be happening to DC< Axar has had a superb season both with bat and ball. On this slow pitch, he has lofted a slow flighted wide ball over extra cover for a six. He gets on a knee to access it
full and straight, driven wide of long-on, and they come back for two
looking for a big hit, ends up slicing this to deep cover
follows him as Axar back away. He hits it hard and back at Theekshana, some might call this a drop, but it is unfair. It hits the top of the finger as he gets his hands down
slower ball, goes under the toe of his swinging bat
slower ball, short of a length, runs it down to deep third for one
full, really full, driven straight to mid-off. The asking rate keeps rising
misses the yorker, and Axar crushes that low full toss through extra cover for four
wide length ball, slower one at 133ks, he opens the face for a single
quick, outside off, 143ks, beats his push
punched down to long-off for one
edged, and falls short of Rahane at slip
release close to the umpire, on a length, wicket to wicket, nudged to leg for one

is that the final seal on the game? Rossouw has to try a big hit, and he ends up mis-hitting this one to long-on. Actually this ball is quite in the slot, but he has played a bit of a nothing shot. Not a full-blooded sweep, not a straight loft. He is disappointed with himself
makes room to hit this hard but gets just a single to long-off
turn from middle and off, defended back to him
offbreak, punched to leg, a fumble at short midwicket allows them a single
connects this one but just a single to long-off
looks to cut but it is turning too much, and he gets a bottom edge
sharp turn from outside off, goes for a leg-bye
pushes this to deep cover for one
no turn, beats the inside edge, hits the pad, but going down leg

as plumb as an lbw can get. Pandey is sitting deep in his crease again, looking for an error in length, but Pathirahna bowls a 149ks yorker. You don't really need an umpire to give this one out. A forgettable night for Pandey comes to an end
short, and because of his low release, not much bounce. Miscues the pull to square leg
short of a length, no room, punched to deep cover
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover for one
shortens the length, punched back to Pathirana. Rossouw is out of his crease, but Pathirana is staring at Pandey even as he scampers back
Pandey welcomes pace on the ball. Stays back in the crease, hoping for a full ball, and gets it. Slogs him over midwicket for a rare six
sharp turn across his body, pitches leg, rips past his bat and hits his thigh pad
stays back to pull a length ball but gets just the single
dropped into the covers for another single
stays in the crease to nudge it to leg for one
down the wicket, nowhere near the pitch of the ball, and plays it straight to short midwicket
turns from leg to off, Rossouw can't do much else than opening the face for a single
makes room to cut this, and Theekshan at short cover puts in a dive to save three runs
stays on the target, on a length, and Pandey places it past cover for one
on a length, 96ks, no room, pushed wide of cover for one
on a length, no room, pushed into the covers
tossed up outside off, outside edge to short third
short of a length, cut away, Theekshana makes a diving save at deep point to save two runs
shuffles to sweep, Moeen goes full and straight for the lbw, Rossouw gets some bat on it for a single
on a length, middle and off, 91ks, defended back to him
another charge and hope. The ball turns, takes a thick inside edge for a single to deep midwicket
Pandey forced to take a risk. Jumps out of the crease, Moeen shortens the length, and beats him in the flight. Hit on the pad
fires this in, short of a length, and again short straight midwicket is in action
offbreak, on a length, and that short straight midwicket is at a perfect angle to deny them one
on a length, outside off, pushed to short straight cover
shaping up for reverse? In the end plays a normal cover-drive for two to deep extra cover
corrects the line, Rossouw defends now
overpitched, also wide, Rososuw plays a lovely extra-cover drive for four
on a length, middle and leg, nudged into the leg side for one
a touch short, cut away top deep cover for one
corrects the length, pushed down the ground but can't beat short straight midwicket
oh he has overpitched this one. And it is turning in. Pandey lofts it back over his head for six
offbreak, into the pads, defended to leg
this turns away, pushed wide of cover for one
defends this one back to him
big turn from a full length. And Moeen does give it a good rip. Beaten by the offbreak on the ha;f-volley
slows it down to 91ks now, and gets appreciable turn. Pandey all at sea
this one doesn't turn, and is bowled at 101ks. Defended
fired in. at 94ks, still some turn, defended with an open face
flatter, quicker, punched down to long-on for one
turn and bounce. Slows it down, on a length, and beats him on the inside edge
on a length, outside off, pushed to short extra cover
full, wicket to wicket, pushed into the covers for one more
offbreak, pushed to long-on for one. Big back lift, and he has to recover as the ball turns in
full, middle and off, driven to long-off
leading edge. Pandey looks to turn it to leg, and the carrom ball turns. Just wide of Theekshana
on a length, no room, he backs away to hit it to cover for one
full and quick, defended back to him
looks to loft over mid-on, gets a thick inside edge, and luckily it keeps running away from mid-on for four
short of a length, bottom edge to extra cover, and he has to dive to get himself in
superb shot. Down the wicket, Chahar on a length at 128ks, and he has punched an off-drive between the bowler and mid-off
short of a length, opens the face, straight to point. Yes-no again
pick-up pull. In an ideal world this is what would be happening more often than not to 126ks short balls that are coming up waist high, but this pitch is not predictable
on a length, swinging in, middle and leg, defended to leg
on a length, top of off, pushed wide of mid-off for one
on a length, around off, defended with an open face
pulled away but no timing, gets a single to deep square leg
a forward-defensive
on a length, outside off, defended

they are both at the same end. Pandey has sold a dummy to Marsh. Looks to drop and run, takes a start, and then turns his back on Marsh, who is gone too far down the pitch. Rahane does well to not throw. Imagine you are Pandey, you don't play every game, how easy or difficult is it to sacrifice yourself?
looking for swing, ends up bowling a wide full toss, driven between cover and point for four
swinging away, around off, on a length, defended
short of a length, into the body, tucked away to long leg

what do we know? Short at 126ks can work. The line is a little wider, and the ball stops in the pitch. Salt has to drag the pull, and also the slowness of the pitch makes him check his shot. A top edge ensues, and he is caught at mid-on
not missing out this time. Short balls at 128ks that don't get chest high can work only for so long. Pulls this over deep midwicket for a 100m six
Salt misses out on a gift down the leg side. Gets a wide, but would have liked to have hit a six
too slow off the surface. Salt tries to pull, the ball is bowled at 126ks, he is early into the shot, and is hit in the ribs
short of a length, outside off, angling in, punched wide of mid-off for one
Salt has arrived. Down the wicket again, knows there can't be another bouncer, and pulls him straight down the ground clean over long-on
short of a length, just angled too far down, and Salt tucks it away off the hip for four through fine leg
charges at him, Deshpande slips in a quick bouncer and beats his hook
whoa that is unplayable. Short of a length, 135ks, seams away from him. Salt is getting peach after peach
looking for swing, goes too straight, lucky to go for just the eg-bye
on a length, outside off, Salt gets a bottom edge as he looks to cut it
big outswinger. Swings late, from middle and off, and beats his outside edge

big shout for pad first, and they have reviewed it. I think the umpire was raising his finger and stopped himself, thinking there is an inside edge here. It is a lovely outswinger, but it swings less than expected and Salt gets an inside edge. Review lost
Chahar tries the full outswinger, overpitches, Marsh plays the on-drive, but they have long-on back

wicket second ball. Signs of a slow pitch. These are not slower ones but Chahar is bowling at 127ks, Short, wide, Warner wants to cut again, and again he ends up hitting in front of square. Also unable to get on top of the bounce, and hits it in the air
slower ball first up, short of a length, 126ks, Warner ends up cutting it to extra cover
